subject: 4000 Mississippi Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to continue reviewing a Chapter 40B comprehensive permit application for a proposed 350-unit development at 4000 Mississippi Parkway. The board reviewed project revisions from a working session, discussed construction fire safety recommendations with city officials, and continued the hearing to May 8, 2023.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Extension Announcement
items.summary: Denis MacDougall announced the extension of remote public meeting provisions under the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law through March 31, 2025.

items.title: 4000 Mississippi Parkway Comprehensive Permit
items.summary: The board reviewed updated site plans, loading configurations, and fire safety recommendations for a proposed 350-unit Chapter 40B development before voting to continue the public hearing to May 8, 2023.
